issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: iron_bars, red_wall_banner, stone_brick_wall.

notes.detail: Iron bars in the slits, red banner, wall torches on the merlons at x0 y6 and x4 y7, lamp post on the raised walk.
notes.depth: Front has footing, corbels and slits; the inner (back, z2) face is a flat 5-high slab of brick with only cobble patches.
notes.roof: Joins otherwise match: left end (x0) = straight profile (walk stand y5, parapet y5, merlon y6 at x0); right end (x4) = straight profile +1 (stand y6, parapet y6, merlon y7 at x4); the stair at x2 y5 z1-z2 faces east, so the walk climbs the right way.
notes.life: Lantern and torches; no greenery yet.

visual.summary: L1 plus iron bars, a red wall banner, two wall torches and a lantern on a wall post on the raised end of the walk.
problems: Corbel course does not step with the parapet: corbels (upside-down stone_brick_stairs) run at y4 z0 across x0-x4, so at x2-x4 the raised parapet is 2 courses tall (y5+y6) above them, while the raised straight piece that joins at the right end has its corbels at y5. The corbel line jumps at the right-hand join instead of with the parapet at x2. Fix: put the corbels at x2-x4 on y5 z0 (stone_brick_stairs facing=south, half=top) and make y4 z0 x2-x4 air, so the right end matches the straight profile raised by 1 everywhere.
Lamp post at x4 z2 y6 sits right at the right-hand join and halves the walk there; moving it to x3 would keep the joint clear (minor).
